result.title: TaCo: Rethinking Correlation for Visual Tracking on Edge Devices
result.summary: Lightweight trackers have replaced cross-correlation with attention, and on low-power edge hardware they pay for it, since memory-bound softmax, normalization and reshaping operators of attention cost far more time than their arithmetic suggests. Benchmarking efficient trackers on an edge Neural Processing Unit (NPU) and an Arm CPU under one numerically validated protocol, we find that correlation trackers are the fast ones, but they lag in accuracy unless they adopt a ViT backbone, which brings attention back. We revisit what correlation lacks. Template--search interaction serves two roles: conditioning the search features on the target and matching them against it spatially. Attention does both, whereas correlation only matches, and does so on features extracted without knowledge of the target. We present TaCo (Target-aligned Correlation), which supplies the missing conditioning without attention by letting the template enter the per-frame network only as operands computed once per video. A descriptor of the target scales and shifts the search features channel by channel inside the backbone, and kernels aligned with the target box, each with a weight predicted from the template, correlate with them in one matrix product. With the backbone fixed, our correlation remains essential while incurring negligible NPU overhead, offering a better speed-accuracy trade-off than the attention-based interactions we tested. TaCo-T achieves 62.3% LaSOT AUC at 184 FPS on the Rockchip RV1126B NPU and 96 FPS on a Raspberry Pi 5 CPU, 3.0x and 3.5x the NPU speed of HiT-Tiny and AsymTrack-T at higher accuracy. TaCo-B reaches 65.6% at 50 FPS on the NPU, more than twice the speed of HiT-Base, AsymTrack-B and LightFC-vit, again at higher accuracy. Code and models are available at https://github.com/TsingWei/TaCo-Tracker.

AI.brief_summary: 论文重新审视轻量跟踪器中相关运算的作用，提出 TaCo：用模板导出的描述符在 backbone 内对搜索特征做通道级缩放与平移，并以目标框对齐、权重由模板预测的核完成匹配，在 NPU 与 Arm CPU 上取得优于 attention 类交互的速度-精度权衡。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「以模板描述符调制特征、用目标对齐核一次矩阵乘完成匹配」的轻量条件注入方式，可能为 LVR 中低成本把视觉证据注入内部状态、替代 attention 提供可供核查的思路，但论文本身不涉及推理或 latent 状态。
